tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: Enumerate open PRs in a GitHub repository (titles, numbers, authors). Use when you need a catalog of pull requests. Do not use for reading patch contents — call get_pull_request_diff for that.

owner.description: GitHub org or user that owns the repository (e.g. "vercel").

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix (e.g. "next.js").

state.description: Optional filter: open, closed, or all. Defaults to open.

tools.name: get_pull_request_diff
tools.description: Return the unified patch/diff body for one pull request by number. Use when reviewing or summarizing code changes in a known PR. Prefer list_pull_requests first if you only have a title and still need the number.

owner.description: GitHub org or user that owns the repository.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix.

number.description: Pull request number (positive integer from the PR URL or list).

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event on the user's primary calendar. Use when scheduling a meeting with a known title, start, and end time. Do not use for listing availability — prefer find_free_slots.

title.description: Short event title shown on the calendar.

start.description: ISO-8601 start datetime including timezone offset.

end.description: ISO-8601 end datetime including timezone offset.

attendees.description: Optional list of attendee email addresses.
